source_claims_used: Reflexion uses linguistic/verbal feedback rather than weight updates.
Agents reflect on task feedback and keep reflective text in an episodic memory buffer for subsequent trials.
The framework accepts feedback from multiple sources; the released implementation includes retry/reflection strategies over previous attempts.

chat_native_reduction.feedback_signal: only durable role-local externally/mechanically observed outcomes are factual; internally simulated feedback is advisory NONFACTUAL
chat_native_reduction.reflection: bounded verbal repair note derived from permitted feedback; it has no authority and cannot certify success, completion, utility or credit
chat_native_reduction.episodic_memory: role-local durable lessons indexed by stable transition identity; memory cannot import forbidden semantic inputs or overwrite root/config/control
chat_native_reduction.retry: a reflection may influence a later safe attempt only after pending recovery and the sealed selector decision; repeated no-progress reflection triggers switch/block
chat_native_reduction.evaluation: terminal utility remains independently sealed and read back; reflective memory itself is not terminal evidence

interpretation_guard: Constructed recurring-Chat controller conformance only; no Reflexion benchmark, episodic-learning effectiveness, or literal agent/model-runtime claim. Counterfactual CAND-STRESS-009T family semantics were not read.
